## Summary

I investigated ticket T-3008 and found that the clickhouse-2 pod is stuck in `ContainerCreating` status in the analytics namespace. The pod logs revealed that the CSI storage driver is unable to mount the persistent volume because the Corvane storage array's host group `hg-k8s-prod` has reached its maximum LUN mapping capacity of 512. This is a storage infrastructure issue requiring cleanup of existing LUN mappings on the array. I escalated the ticket to a human engineer who has access to the Corvane storage infrastructure to resolve the LUN mapping limit issue.
